title: Avenra: Main Health
description: Avenra health for a local cluster: request and create journeys, latency, state transitions, node disk, and the shim and sidecar services. Not a parity or production-readiness claim.

options.content:
Avenra application panels require metrics routed to the configured OTLP backend. Installing Grafana does not change producer routing.

**No data does not imply healthy or zero.** Select a time range within the backend retention window. Counts use a sliding `$window` window; rates are per second and latencies remain milliseconds. Environment, cluster, service and version default to All. Optional logs open in a separate dashboard.

panels.title: Avenra series seen in selected range
panels.description:
Local collection diagnostic; not a source-dashboard widget.
Counts stored series, including histogram streams, over the selected range; not a count of healthy services.
Missing data is not zero. Avenra services must select OTLP and the local metrics-specific endpoint; installing this dashboard does not change routing.

panels.title: Signals without a local data source

options.content:
These signals are intentionally **not replaced with invented metrics or zeros**:

- **APM / `trace.*`, service summaries and daemon QPS:** need a trace backend or a reviewed span-metrics pipeline. Per-service daemon cards are consolidated into one panel here.
- **`proc.avenra.*`, `system.processes.*`, Kubernetes health:** process and infrastructure integrations are not scraped by this Collector.
- **Lifecycle census, stuck/failed counts, duplicate-session creates:** database-monitoring custom queries, not Avenra Rust OTLP metrics.
- **Shim QPS / latency:** the Go shim metric path is not proven to feed this receiver; no guessed series are queried.
- **Alerts / SLOs:** no paging, SLO or monitor migration.
- **Client-side events and logs-minus-spans formulas:** out of scope; this deployment collects Avenra only, not client logs or spans.

See the companion **Avenra logs** dashboard for translated Avenra event panels.
